    Profile

    The leading knight of the Ira Belt region, Andechs is a passionate man who sticks to his ideals of justice no matter the situation. His excellent swordsmanship and situational awareness have lead his allies to place utmost faith in him on the battlefield--no matter how tough their opponent. He is not one to stand on ceremony, and often sports a casual demeanor.

    Origin: Ira Belt
    Gender: Male
    Height: 186cm
    Weight: 76kg
    Birthday: Jan 26
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Bright Knight
    Likes: Looking straight
    Hobbies: Coin tossing
    Illust: RINZO（G-ROW）
    CV: 大村涼
